assumptions: Consumes caller-supplied planet/environment model cues and stable planet/location identities read-only.
limitations: Generated relief is not canonical elevation or surveyed topography.
Tectonic, volcanic, impact, erosion, drainage, lake, wetland, coastline and substrate outputs are bounded model cues, not measured physical truth.

fidelity.validity: Supported solid, oceanic, airless, icy and arid surface presentation contexts; giant no-surface states fail closed
fidelity.resolution: Continuous spherical field plus bounded local drainage probes and traces
fidelity.uncertainty: Heuristic model-derived morphology; exact plate histories, measured elevations, physical flow rates and canonical watershed boundaries are not claimed

assumptions: Selected planet, canonical identity, selection, temporal history and parent commitment are supplied by their existing authorities.
limitations: Surface location and patch identities are deterministic derived addresses, not replacement canonical geodesy or selection authority.
PX context refinement does not promote presentation terrain into physical truth.

fidelity.validity: Supported normalized microdegree latitude/longitude and cube-sphere LOD addresses
fidelity.resolution: LOD 0 through 20 with LOD-independent normalized location identity
fidelity.uncertainty: Address mapping is mathematical/derived; it is not a terrain or camera measurement

assumptions: Caller supplies the selected planet model and consumes the result as derived placement/traversal context.
limitations: Planet-centered coordinates are normalized unit-sphere vectors, not canonical metres or surveyed geodesy.
Relief, hydrology, substrate and placement fields do not assign vegetation eligibility, structure suitability, organism presence, traversal safety or resource truth.
Camera, selection and canonical spatial-reference authority remain external.

fidelity.validity: Global continuous planet-centered unit-sphere queries across dateline, poles, cube faces and LOD 0 through 20
fidelity.resolution: Stable LOD-independent location identity with local tangent frame and bounded model-derived placement context
fidelity.uncertainty: No canonical radius/elevation datum; geology/hydrology fields are model-derived cues

assumptions: Consumes V2X-06 model-derived surface geography/hydrology and caller-owned surface location context read-only.
Adaptive detail demand and resource pressure are caller-supplied presentation hints and never camera or selection truth.
limitations: Grid relief, coast lines, river paths, substrate hooks, morph maps and LOD patch boundaries are presentation representations.
Mixed-LOD witnesses prove deterministic sample coincidence and transition anchoring; they do not claim physical elevation or a central GPU stitch implementation.

PX request/result envelopes remain capped by the frozen one-megabyte provider contract; the terrain materializer's separately bounded aggregate working-set and cache budgets are internal runtime resources, not permission to enlarge a PX envelope.
No central renderer, camera, selection, persistence or event-admission authority is owned by this provider.

fidelity.validity: Bounded active regional/local terrain materialization including same-level and mixed-LOD seams
fidelity.resolution: Odd-grid cube-sphere patches; adaptive 9/17/33 presentation grids; cache bounded independently by entries and estimated working-set bytes while each PX provider envelope remains at or below one megabyte
fidelity.uncertainty: Visual morphology and transition geometry are model/presentation-derived and not canonical elevation

assumptions: Consumes a bounded hierarchical terrain materialization and emits Canvas2D/SVG presentation only.
limitations: SVG/Canvas output is not scientific measurement or GPU certification.
Relief shading, coastline strokes and river-width hierarchy are visual encodings only.
When caller limits are smaller than available geometry, omissions are deterministic, bounded and explicitly reported in the frame witness.

The standalone renderer can be configured with a larger internal SVG safety ceiling, but PX-mediated requests/results remain bounded to the frozen one-megabyte provider envelope and must truncate or fail closed rather than expand registry authority.
Integration into the convergence-owned central renderer router is not performed by this lane.

fidelity.validity: Regional/local model-derived terrain frames and explicit no-solid-surface states
fidelity.resolution: Bounded terrain-cell, coastline and river command streams with relief shading and explicit truncation accounting; PX-mediated payloads remain at or below one megabyte
fidelity.uncertainty: Rendered scale, relief shading, colors, coastlines and flow paths are presentation cues
